https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/2.text:
Cameroon’s ex-rebels caught between hiding and broken promises
Cameroon’s former rebels face arrest fears and failed reintegration.
Douala, Cameroon – Collins Mbah says he hunted down and killed several Cameroonian soldiers in the English-speaking Northwest region during his time as a separatist fighter between 2016 and 2020. Today, in the coastal city of Douala, the man in his mid-30s, who went by the name Commander No Sorrow, has taken on a different role: traditional healer, tending to lives rather than taking them.
Mbah says he abandoned the armed struggle after realising that fellow fighters were turning against the very people they had set out to protect. But he has firmly ruled out joining the government’s disarmament, demobilisation and reintegration (DDR) programme.
“Quitting the struggle and joining the government disarmament programme would have meant I betrayed the people,” said Mbah, who dropped out of secondary school to join the revolt. “I don’t want to have anything to do with the government or the struggle any more. All I need now is peace of mind,” he told Al Jazeera.
October marked a decade since protests erupted in Cameroon’s English-speaking Northwest and Southwest regions, eventually escalating into an armed conflict between separatist fighters and government forces.
The unrest began in late 2016 after Anglophone lawyers and teachers protested against the appointment of Francophone magistrates unfamiliar with British common law to courts in English-speaking regions, and French-speaking teachers unable to communicate fluently in English to schools there. The protests were met with a government crackdown and eventually gave rise to a separatist movement seeking independence for the two regions, which its supporters call “Ambazonia”.
The conflict has killed thousands of people, displaced hundreds of thousands and disrupted education across the two English-speaking regions, according to humanitarian and human rights organisations. New figures released in October by the Cameroonian nonprofit Centre for Human Rights and Democracy in Africa (CHRDA) suggest the death toll could be as high as 10,000.
The fighting remains deadlocked, with separatist groups continuing attacks and kidnappings while the government pursues a military campaign. Alongside its military operations, the government has launched a community dialogue initiative, after distancing itself from Swiss- and Canadian-supported peace efforts.
Prime Minister Joseph Dion Ngute launched the initiative in Buea, the capital of Southwest, in September and in Bamenda, the capital of the Northwest, on October 15. Local leaders are being encouraged to persuade fighters to surrender and enter DDR centres. At the two events, 55 fighters – 25 in the Southwest and 30 in the Northwest – were presented as having renounced the armed struggle.
Life beyond the battlefield
Despite leaving the rebellion, Mbah says he remains on the government’s wanted list. Without a national identity card, the father of three struggles to move freely around Douala and occasionally ventures into the outskirts to collect traditional herbs.
“I was initiated into traditional healing during childhood. The amulets and concoctions helped me foresee any danger when I was on the war front. Today, I use the same to heal,” he said. “But I don’t stay in a particular neighbourhood for long – I always move to the next to avoid being caught.”
Mbah is among former fighters who have chosen to reintegrate into society independently rather than enter government-run rehabilitation centres. Many say they fear arrest or poor treatment if they surrender.
Peter Mosongo, 28, now works as a motorcycle taxi rider in Buea after leaving the struggle in 2019. He joined in 2018 to protect his family but quit after witnessing what he describes as the indiscriminate killing of civilians by fellow fighters.
“I received threats from the fighters when I quit. They even kidnapped my father to force him to produce me,” Mosongo said. “I didn’t join DDR upon quitting out of fear that I may end up in prison. It was also being rumoured that those who surrendered were being killed silently.”
Mosongo says he also lost two cousins to the conflict.
Another former fighter, Richard Bende, left in 2019 because he believed the rebellion had become a “scores-settling venture”. He had fought government soldiers in Bamusso, in the Southwest, and now works as a secondary school history and geography teacher. Like Mbah and Mosongo, he avoided the DDR programme, citing concerns about the treatment of former fighters at its centres.
Broken promises inside DDR centres
Paul Mukete, who fought in Kumba from 2017 to 2020 under the nickname King of Vultures, chose a different path. But six years after entering the DDR programme in Tiko town, in the Southwest, he says he has little to show for it.
Apart from learning poultry and pig farming, Mukete says he has received no psychological care.
“We gave intelligence information to the military, who used it to kill some separatist fighters who refused to lay down their weapons,” he said. “We were about 600 in the DDR centre, but many have since left out of frustration. Some even rejoined the struggle and got killed.”
The 29-year-old father of three now takes on odd jobs to support his family.
His account raises questions about whether the programme is providing former fighters with the support they need to rebuild their lives and remain out of the conflict.
Fonbeh Hedwick Chia, a mental health specialist and founder of the Bamenda-based Living Vine Mental Health Services, says both fighters and civilians in the English-speaking regions have been exposed to psychological trauma.
He argues that the DDR centres lack the therapeutic support needed to rehabilitate former fighters, estimating that about 800 have renounced the armed struggle.
“The government is more concerned with the propaganda made when they come to the DDR than their integral welfare,” Chia told Al Jazeera, arguing that former fighters need psychological care to address the trauma of atrocities committed and witnessed during the conflict.
Without proper rehabilitation, he warns, former fighters risk remaining marginalised and could become a source of further instability.
The accounts of former fighters and Chia’s assessment point to a central challenge for the DDR programme: persuading rebels to surrender is only the first step, while helping them return to civilian life requires sustained support.
A conflict rooted in colonial history
Cameroon’s Anglophone crisis has roots in its colonial past. Initially colonised by Germany in 1884, the territory was divided between Britain and France after World War I.
French Cameroon gained independence in 1960. In 1961, British-administered Southern Cameroons voted in a United Nations-organised plebiscite to join the independent Republic of Cameroon, forming a federal state. The arrangement was dissolved in 1972 following a controversial referendum, ending the Anglophone regions’ federal status.
Unlike some conflicts involving more centralised rebel movements, Cameroon’s separatist rebellion has no single command structure. Dozens of smaller factions operate across Northwest and Southwest, with some receiving financial support and weapons from diaspora groups.
The prolonged fighting has brought human rights abuses by both government forces and separatists. Some armed groups have also shifted towards criminal activities, including kidnapping for ransom.
Chris Roberts, a political scientist at the University of Calgary in Canada, says the conflict is rooted less in language differences than in “decades of poor governance from a political system that has kept the same president in power since 1982”.
Although the government has repeatedly claimed the war is over, Roberts says continued firefights, ambushes and attacks demonstrate otherwise.
He argues that political reform in Yaoundé is essential to ending the conflict. He describes the October 2025 presidential election as “strategically rigged” and argues that it offers little prospect of resolving the crisis. A future presidential succession crisis could create opportunities for reform but also risk destabilising the country.
“There will not be a military solution to this war,” Roberts said.

https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/.title: Eisenkot condemns 'Jewish terrorism' near Ramallah as US congressman calls for accountability
https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/.author: Ayse Betul Aytekin
https://www.middleeasteye.net/live-blog/.text:
Eisenkot condemns 'Jewish terrorism' near Ramallah as US congressman calls for accountability
Israeli politician Gadi Eisenkot has condemned a series of arson attacks by settlers in the occupied West Bank as "Jewish terrorism", accusing far-right ministers Bezalel Smotrich and Itamar Ben Gvir of fuelling violence against Palestinians.
Overnight into Sunday, Israeli settlers attacked three Palestinian villages near Ramallah, setting fire to vehicles and spray-painting racist slogans on residential buildings.
Eisenkot, leader of the Yashar party, described the attacks as "Jewish terrorism in every sense of the word" and called on the government and security establishment to take tougher action against violent settlers.
"The acts of sabotage carried out by extremist groups setting fire to vehicles and homes undermine regional stability, endanger lives and seriously harm Israel's national security and foreign relations," he wrote on X.
Opposition leader Yair Lapid also condemned the attacks, calling them "Jewish terrorism" caused by government negligence.
"Jewish terrorism is the product of criminal negligence on the part of the Israeli government," Lapid said. "By remaining silent, government ministers are deliberately encouraging these pogroms."
"When we form a government, we will tackle this terrorism and restore governance, law and order," he added.
In the United States, Democratic Congressman Josh Gottheimer condemned the attacks and called for accountability.
"These incidents warrant a full and thorough investigation," Gottheimer wrote on X, adding that vigilante justice had "no place" in society.
Israeli police said they had opened investigations into arson, vandalism and property damage.

https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026.title: Abdul El-Sayed doubles down on ‘TrumpCare’ health plan, urging president to ‘get it done’
https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026.author: Keely Aouga
https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026.text:
Michigan US senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed on Sunday doubled down on naming healthcare reform legislation after Donald Trump as long as it meant the president would not impede its passage.
“If he’s open to the conversation, I am open to it, too,” El-Sayed said of Trump on Sunday. “If the president is opening to signing that bill, let’s get it done.”
El-Sayed made those remarks on Sunday on NBC’s Meet the Press, where he reiterated his pledge to pursue a single-payer, national healthcare program after the Democrat became the first Muslim person elected to the US Senate during the midterms earlier in November.
Trump’s Republican party is going to lose control of Congress for the second half of his second presidency. But the president has made clear his intention to wield his legislative veto powers whenever he sees fit.
Appearing on Sunday’s Meet the Press, El-Sayed said he would not mind Medicare for All – a big part of his campaign platform – being named “TrumpCare” as long as such a program came into existence.
“I care that the people of this country finally have the unmet promise of guaranteed healthcare in this country. And if the president is serious about leaving a lasting legacy, there is nothing better than the ultimate Trump card,” El-Sayed said to Meet the Press host Kristen Welker, making a double entendre for a term that – when the T is lowercase – also refers to a card that beats out others in card games.
El-Sayed told Welker that such a Trump card would be in effect “from the moment [people] are born to the moment that they pass away – that guarantees them the healthcare that has been so elusive in this country without premiums, co-pays and deductibles”.
The senator-elect’s comments come after he previously suggested to CNN that he is not above stroking Trump’s prodigious ego to get legislation passed – including by naming Medicare for All “TrumpCare”.
He also previously wrote on social media, alongside images of a gold health insurance card with “TrumpCare” inscribed on it: “Donald, this is on the table. Guarantee healthcare for every American, from cradle to grave.”
Trump seemingly responded to El-Sayed’s post by reposting a screenshot of the senator-elect’s tweet. Trump has not formally responded to the push to create universal healthcare.
Trump has spent much of his second presidency trying to get as much as possible named after him – from institutions, physical buildings and currency.
El-Sayed also said that he supports healthcare reform proposed by Bernie Sanders, the progressive US senator.
Sanders’ proposal would create a single-payer system in which the federal government insures everybody, financed by an increase in taxes, while eliminating private insurance.
But El-Sayed said he is not focused on eliminating private insurance as an option, which Sanders aims to eliminate by having everything primary and preventive services to hospital stays covered under his proposed plan. Out-of-pocket costs on deductibles and co-pays – staples of the rapacious private insurance industry to which most Americans must resort – would also be eliminated under Sanders’ plan.
El-Sayed said he wants to “provide you basic public health insurance no matter who you are in this country” while being open to the idea of not taking alternative options away.
The senator-elect said he has a meeting on the books with JD Vance. El-Sayed would not share the agenda of the meeting, but he confirmed that the vice-president’s chief of staff contacted him after his election victory.

https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.title: ‘Terrorismo judaico’: Eisenkot cobra punição por ataques de colonos contra palestinos
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.author: Redação
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.text:
Autoridades israelenses anunciaram, neste domingo (22), a abertura de uma investigação após veículos e edifícios palestinos serem incendiados e vandalizados em quatro vilarejos da Cisjordânia ocupada. Segundo o Exército israelense, soldados e policiais foram mobilizados durante a madrugada após receberem denúncias e imagens dos ataques. A corporação condenou os atos, enquanto a polícia confirmou a abertura de uma investigação.
Em Kafr Malik, cerca de oito veículos foram incendiados e frases racistas foram pichadas nos muros de residências, segundo o ativista local Jihad Al Qaq, ouvido pela agência internacional AFP. Imagens divulgadas nas redes sociais mostram veículos em chamas e inscrições com referências à Judeia, termo utilizado por setores da extrema direita israelense para designar parte da Cisjordânia.
O líder oposicionista israelense e ex-chefe das Forças Armadas Gadi Eisenkot classificou os ataques como terrorismo judaico e responsabilizou as políticas dos ministros Itamar Ben Gvir e Bezalel Smotrich pelo agravamento da situação na região. Eisenkot é membro do partido Yashar e defendeu medidas de segurança para deter os responsáveis.
“A atividade de sabotagem de grupos extremistas que incendeiam veículos e casas abala a estabilidade regional, põe em risco vidas humanas e causa um dano grave à segurança nacional do Estado de Israel e às suas relações exteriores”, escreveu em sua conta no X.
Eisenkot também cobrou uma resposta efetiva do governo e do sistema de segurança israelense, incluindo detenções administrativas e ações da Agência de Segurança de Israel (Shin Bet) contra os envolvidos.
O ex-general foi escolhido pelo presidente de Israel, Isaac Herzog, para formar o próximo governo do país. O líder da oposição tem até 6 de dezembro para apresentar uma maioria parlamentar, com possibilidade de prorrogação por mais 14 dias.
Em outra manifestação nas redes sociais, Yousef Jabareen, líder do partido árabe-israelense Hadash, defendeu a articulação entre judeus e árabes para substituir o atual governo de Benjamin Netanyahu, Itamar Ben Gvir e Bezalel Smotrich. Segundo ele, a cooperação política é necessária diante do que considera uma ameaça à sociedade árabe e israelense.
“O terrorismo dos colonos na Cisjordânia não ocorre no vácuo. Ele é o resultado direto do aprofundamento da ocupação e de uma política governamental em que a violência contra palestinos se tornou uma rotina diária”, declarou Jabareen. Na sequência, ele escreveu outra postagem em que pede a união de judeus e árabes contra o governo de Benjamin Netanyahu, que perdeu maioria do parlamento nas eleições de outubro, e segue como primeiro-ministro interino.
A Cisjordânia é ocupada por Israel desde 1967. O território abriga mais de meio milhão de israelenses em assentamentos considerados ilegais pelo direito internacional e aproximadamente três milhões de palestinos.
Segundo levantamento da AFP, baseado em dados do Ministério da Saúde palestino, pelo menos 1.119 palestinos foram mortos por soldados ou colonos israelenses na Cisjordânia desde outubro de 2023. No mesmo período, pelo menos 51 israelenses, incluindo militares, morreram em ataques palestinos ou confrontos no território, de acordo com números oficiais israelenses. Um deles era o filho de Eisenkot.
A investigação anunciada pelas autoridades israelenses deverá apurar as circunstâncias dos ataques e identificar os responsáveis.
Com informações AFP e Opera Mundi

https://taz.de/Einwanderungsland-Deutsch.title: Einwanderungsland Deutschland: Die demografische Wirklichkeit „migrantischer Milieus“
https://taz.de/Einwanderungsland-Deutsch.author: Jens Schneider
https://taz.de/Einwanderungsland-Deutsch.text:
Einwanderungsland Deutschland : Die demografische Wirklichkeit „migrantischer Milieus“
Wer Deutschsein über das Aussehen definiert, hat das Einwanderungsland Deutschland nicht verstanden. Was braucht es überhaupt, um deutsch zu sein?
S chon als es im späten Frühjahr 2020 in Frankfurt am Main und Stuttgart zu Ausschreitungen zwischen Jugendlichen und der Polizei kam, waren Politik und Medien – und wohl auch die Polizei – überrascht zu sehen, dass so viele der Jugendlichen dem Augenschein nach einen „Migrationshintergrund“ hatten.
Mit Blick auf das, was nach den Gen-Z-Demonstrationen in Frankfurt, Köln, Hamburg und Berlin passierte, wiederholt sich dieses Muster nahezu wortgleich: Die Tatsache, dass man den vorrangig männlichen Randalierern eine „migrantische“ Herkunft anzusehen scheint, wird besonders hervorgehoben. Sie werden als ganz offensichtlich „nicht gut integriert“ dargestellt. „Migrantische Milieus“ sind diskursiv zudem näher an Clankriminalität zu verorten als an so etwas wie gesellschaftlicher Normalität.
Auch die Stadtbild-Debatte, angestoßen von Friedrich Merz und kürzlich aktualisiert von seinem Parteikollegen, dem hessischen Ministerpräsidenten Boris Rhein, hat gezeigt, wie sehr die CDU mit der Vielfalt der deutschen Jugend fremdelt. Sie stellt den immer gleichen Kurzschluss her: dass die Sichtbarkeit von Migrantinnen und Migranten – und allen, die dafür gehalten werden – ein Indikator für das Maß an Kriminalität und weiteren unerwünschten Verhaltensweisen sei.
taz debatte
Die taz ist eine unabhängige, linke und meinungsstarke Tageszeitung. In unseren Kommentaren, Essays und Debattentexten streiten wir seit der Gründung der taz im Jahr 1979. Oft können und wollen wir uns nicht auf eine Meinung einigen. Deshalb finden sich hier teils komplett gegenläufige Positionen – allesamt Teil des sehr breiten linken Meinungsspektrums.
Ist das rassistisch? Nun, zumindest verwendet es rein äußerliche Merkmale und fragt weder nach Geburtsort noch Staatsangehörigkeit, nicht nach Bildungsniveau, Beruf oder Wohnort, Kriterien also, mit denen das Deutschsein und der soziale Status oder die tatsächliche gesellschaftliche Teilhabe festgestellt werden könnten. Es offenbart aber vor allem eine bemerkenswerte Ahnungslosigkeit im Hinblick auf die tatsächlichen demografischen Verhältnisse in deutschen Städten.
Minderheiten werden zu Mehrheiten
Die Diversität einer lokalen Bevölkerung ist statistisch kaum zu erfassen, weil nur wenige Kriterien wie Geburtsort und Staatsangehörigkeit in den Meldeämtern erhoben werden. Kategorien wie „Migrationshintergrund“ oder „Einwanderungsgeschichte“ sind also sehr grob und erfassen nur einen unter vielen Aspekten.
Außerdem geben die statistischen Kriterien natürlich nicht das wieder, was Politiker mit „migrantischen Milieus“ oder dem „Stadtbild“ meinen, schließlich haben auch Menschen mit Schweizer oder schwedischem Hintergrund bei festem Wohnsitz in Deutschland statistisch einen Migrationshintergrund, dürften aber nicht einmal die Remigrationsfantasien der Rechten befeuern. Mit diesen Einschränkungen im Hinterkopf zeigen die Datenerhebungen wie Zensus und Mikrozensus über die Zeit folgende eindeutige Trends:
forscht am IMIS der Uni Osnabrück zu Identitäten, superdiversen Städten und zur zweiten Generation der Kinder aus Einwandererfamilien.
Weltweit entwickeln sich immer mehr Städte zu „mehrheitlich Minderheiten-Städten“. Das bedeutet, dass die nach gängigen, überwiegend ethnischen Kriterien definierte Mehrheitsbevölkerung weniger als die Hälfte der Gesamtbevölkerung dieser Städte ausmacht. Sie wird eine Minderheit unter vielen. In Europa waren Amsterdam und London schon vor über zehn Jahren Städte, auf die das zutraf: Die „British Whites“ in London und die „autochthonen Niederländer“ in Amsterdam sind zwar immer noch die größte Gruppe, stellen aber eben nicht mehr die absolute Mehrheit.
Das gilt inzwischen auch für Paris, Wien, Genf, Rotterdam, Antwerpen und Malmö. In Deutschland war Frankfurt die erste Großstadt, in der mehr als die Hälfte der Gesamtbevölkerung statistisch einen Migrationshintergrund hat. Diese Zahlen zeigen die ganze Monstrosität – nein, eigentlich eher die Lächerlichkeit rechter Fantasien von „Remigration“.
Remigrationsfantasien sind absurd
Bei Erfurt, Schwerin oder Magdeburg mag es noch vorstellbar sein, dass diese Städte auch ohne die etwa 15 Prozent der Bewohnerinnen und Bewohner mit einer Einwanderungsgeschichte noch irgendwie funktionieren, aber bei Frankfurt ohne mehr als die Hälfte der Gesamtbevölkerung? Noch krasser bei der Jugend, die in vielen westdeutschen Städten schon bis zu drei Viertel der unter 18-Jährigen stellt.
Die Vielfalt wächst von unten hoch. In mehr als der Hälfte aller kreisfreien Städte in Deutschland hat über die Hälfte der Kinder und Jugendlichen statistisch einen Migrationshintergrund. Gleichzeitig sind aber 70 bis 90 Prozent von ihnen in Deutschland geboren und aufgewachsen; nach den gängigen Kriterien erfahrener Einwanderungsländer sind sie schlichtweg einheimische deutsche Kinder. In den allermeisten Städten gibt es zudem Stadtteile, die schon lange als Ausländerviertel oder Migrantenquartiere gelten.
Es handelt sich dabei meist um ehemalige Arbeiterquartiere, die ab den 1970er Jahren billigen Wohnraum für eingewanderte Familien ebenso boten wie für Studierende und die freie Kulturszene. In dem Maße allerdings, wie die Kinder und Enkel dieser Familien höhere Bildungsabschlüsse erreicht haben – und das sind deutlich mehr, als es die Debatte vermuten lässt –, ziehen diese zunehmend auch in bürgerliche Stadtteile und in die Einfamilienhaussiedlungen am Stadtrand. Das heißt, dass auch in diesen Stadtteilen der statistische Anteil der Bevölkerung mit Migrationshintergrund steigt.
Ist das alles ein Problem? Oder gar der Untergang des Abendlandes? Zumindest Amsterdam, London, Paris oder Wien haben auch als mehrheitlich Minderheiten-Städte in den vergangenen zehn Jahren nicht an Attraktivität für den Tourismus oder wirtschaftliche und wissenschaftliche Innovationen verloren – und das gilt auch für die Metropolregionen in Süddeutschland, die sowohl über die größte Wirtschaftskraft als auch die höchsten Anteile Migrationshintergrund verfügen.
Rassismus in der Politik und im Alltag
Die Dynamik der wirtschaftlichen Entwicklung ist interessant und hier lohnt auch der Blick in den Osten Deutschlands: In Dresden und Leipzig hat sich der statistische Anteil von Personen mit einem Migrationshintergrund zwischen 2011 und 2019 von 7 beziehungsweise 8 Prozent auf rund 14 Prozent praktisch verdoppelt. Sind denn wenigstens die Kriminalitätsraten in all diesen Städten höher als woanders?
Sind sie nicht, und es spricht nicht für Hessens Ministerpräsidenten, dass er entweder die demografischen Verhältnisse in seinem Bundesland nicht kennt oder nur versucht, politisch zu punkten, wenn er seine Partei diskursiv näher an die AfD rückt. Sollte es ihm wirklich vor allem darum gehen, die, wie er sagte: „Deutungshoheit über die Alltagsfragen der ganz normalen Menschen“ wiederzuerlangen, so darf man sich wundern, wer für ihn diese „ganz normalen Menschen“ in seinem Bundesland sind.
Diejenigen mit einer Zuwanderungsgeschichte, die knapp die Hälfte der Bevölkerung seines Bundeslands ausmachen, gehören offenbar nicht dazu. Tatsächlich wäre es bemerkenswert gewesen, wenn bei den Protesten nicht mindestens die Hälfte der Jugendlichen einen Migrationshintergrund gehabt hätte. Das Grund- und Gründungsprinzip von Einwanderungsländern ist, dass Integration als intergenerationale Aufgabe verstanden wird, bei der sich die Erwartungen an Teilhabe und Identifikation vor allem an die richtet, deren Eltern zugewandert sind, die aber selbst im Land geboren wurden.
Seltsamerweise haben Gesellschaft und Politik an die zweite und dritte Generation in der Regel kaum noch Erwartungen: Es scheint nur wenig zu kümmern, dass sie im Durchschnitt niedrigere Schulabschlüsse haben und auf dem Arbeitsmarkt benachteiligt werden. Und obwohl sie alle Voraussetzungen dafür mitbringen, ist ihre Brückenfunktion zwischen den Gesellschaften kaum gefragt. Stattdessen bezeichnen sich viele der hier geborenen Kinder und sogar der Enkel selbst noch immer als Ausländer. Offensichtlich wird diesen Kindern regelmäßig vermittelt, dass sie irgendwie nicht richtig dazugehören würden.
Diversität ist der Normalfall
Diskriminierung ist ein starker Einflussfaktor für zu früh beendete Bildungskarrieren, aber auch für eine mögliche Abwendung von der Gesellschaft. Und Diskriminierung ist im Leben von Menschen, die über den Namen oder ihr Aussehen als migrantisch interpretiert werden, von klein auf omnipräsent: Noch immer bekommen sie als Schülerinnen und Schüler schlechtere Noten und Schulempfehlungen für die gleichen Leistungen; noch immer haben sie es schwerer, einen Ausbildungsplatz zu finden, und werden als junge Erwachsene bei gleicher Qualifikation seltener zum Jobinterview eingeladen.
Sie werden häufiger nicht in die Disco gelassen und bekommen auch häufiger die Wohnung nicht, auf die sie sich beworben haben. Konsequente Gegenmaßnahmen: Fehlanzeige oder zumindest nur in rudimentären Ansätzen vorhanden. Das Problem ist aber auch ein grundsätzlicheres, denn das dominante (Selbst-)Verständnis von Deutschsein funktioniert noch immer im Wesentlichen über Abstammung: Wer anders aussieht oder heißt, hat wohl Eltern von woanders, oder Großeltern oder Urgroßeltern oder gar noch viel weiter zurück.
Eine solche Definition nennt man ethnisch – man könnte sie auch völkisch nennen –, weil ihr weitgehend egal ist, wo jemand im Wesentlichen sozialisiert wurde und ob die Person die deutsche Staatsangehörigkeit hat. An den demografischen Gegebenheiten im Einwanderungsland Deutschland geht es völlig vorbei, Deutschsein anhand ethnisch-völkischer Kriterien zu definieren. Dass dies aber nicht nur rechte Fantasiegebilde füttert, sondern die mit Abstand am weitesten verbreitete Alltagspraxis im politisch-medialen Diskurs ist, und zudem fortlaufend insinuiert wird, dass Deutschland irgendwie besser dran wäre, wenn es kein Land mit Migration wäre, ist hochgradig problematisch.
Der für eine Einwanderungsgesellschaft angemessene Gegenentwurf: Wer hier geboren und aufgewachsen ist, ist deutsch, spielt dagegen kaum eine Rolle. Es wird höchste Zeit, dass auch in der Mitte der Gesellschaft ankommt, dass die Diversität der aktuelle Normalfall ist und die mit einer Migrationsgesellschaft einhergehenden demografischen Veränderungen als gegeben angenommen und entproblematisiert werden.
Insbesondere für die Union gäbe es dabei sogar einiges zu gewinnen: Die konsequente Abgrenzung nach rechts, ohne gleichzeitig fortlaufend als Stichwortgeber für rechtspopulistische Parteien zu fungieren, eine Öffnung für das erhebliche konservative Potenzial unter Migrantinnen und Migranten und damit möglicherweise sogar die Rückkehr zu Wahlerfolgen in den Städten diesseits der kleinbürgerlichen Vororte.
Gemeinsam für freie Presse
Die taz gehört zu 100 Prozent ihren Leser:innen und ist damit nicht nur konzernfrei, sondern auch kostenfrei zugänglich. Alle Artikel stellen wir frei zur Verfügung, ohne Paywall. Gerade in diesen Zeiten müssen Einordnungen und Informationen allen zugänglich sein. Unsere Leser:innen müssen nichts bezahlen, wissen aber, dass kritischer, unabhängiger Journalismus nicht aus dem Nichts entsteht. Dafür sind wir sehr dankbar. Damit wir auch morgen noch unseren Journalismus machen können, brauchen wir mehr Unterstützung für taz zahl ich. Dank Ihnen haben wir nun die 50.000 erreicht. So viele unterstützen freiwillig und regelmäßig. Noch nicht dabei? Werden Sie jetzt Teil der Community! Jetzt unterstützen

https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2026/n.title: NFL roundup: Chiefs, Lions and Bills march on; Metcalf ejected for eye poke in Steelers loss
https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2026/n.author: Agencies
https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2026/n.text:
Miami Dolphins 9–26 Buffalo Bills
Greg Rousseau had two sacks, including his team-leading 10th of the season, and Buffalo’s defense bailed out the Bills’ sputtering Josh Allen-led offense in a win over the injury-depleted division rival Miami Dolphins (1-9). Allen was limited to a four-yard touchdown pass to DJ Moore with two interceptions in an outing during which Buffalo settled for three field goals on five drives inside Miami’s 20. James Cook scored on a one-yard run for Buffalo (9-1) and had 89 yards rushing to become the NFL’s second player to score a TD and top 75 yards rushing in nine consecutive outings. Miami has lost four straight and are off to their worst start to a season since going 0-13 to open 2007.
Arizona Cardinals 7–34 Kansas City Chiefs
Patrick Mahomes threw three touchdown passes, two of them to Travis Kelce, and the Chiefs routed the Cardinals. It was the third straight lopsided win for Kansas City following blowouts of the Jets and Falcons. Emmett Johnson added 105 yards rushing and a touchdown in his fourth straight game. The Chiefs improved to 8-2 and will carry some momentum into a high-profile Thanksgiving night matchup in Buffalo. Arizona fell to 3-8. The Cardinals planned to start rookie Carson Beck at quarterback for the second straight game, but he was ruled out on Saturday with back spasms. Josh Johnson was largely ineffective in his place.
Tampa Bay Buccaneers 21–31 Detroit Lions
Jahmyr Gibbs, the NFL’s leading rusher, ran for two touchdowns as the Detroit Lions extended their winning streak to six games. Gibbs rushed for 98 yards on 23 carries and caught four passes for 20 yards. Jared Goff passed for 279 yards and two touchdowns, including a 57-yard strike to Jameson Williams, as the Lions (8-2) kept pace with the Chicago Bears in the NFC North heading into their Thanksgiving Day clash in Detroit. Williams caught four passes for 93 yards and Amon-Ra St Brown added five receptions for 37 yards and a score. Baker Mayfield passed for 187 yards and two touchdowns, both to Ted Hurst III, to pace the Bucs (3-7). Bucky Irving rushed for 68 yards and a score on 18 carries.
Pittsburgh Steelers 16–19 Philadelphia Eagles
Saquon Barkley ran 38 yards for a touchdown to provide a rare spark for the Eagles and helped Philadelphia snap a seven-game losing streak with a win over an ineffective Aaron Rodgers and the Pittsburgh Steelers. Pittsburgh’s losing streak in Philly now spans 12 games over six decades, three stadiums and five Steelers coaches. Rodgers, who turns 43 on 2 December, looked every bit the aging quarterback against a mostly dominant Eagles defense. The Eagles ended their longest skid since they lost eight straight in 2012. Jake Elliott kicked four field goals for Philadelphia. Steelers wide receiver DK Metcalf was ejected for unsportsmanlike conduct in the third quarter. Metcalf was twice involved in fights against the Eagles. He was flagged for unnecessary roughness earlier in the game after he went after cornerback Cooper DeJean. Metcalf appeared to poke DeJean in the eye in the second scuffle, leading to his ejection.
Las Vegas Raiders 24–38 Denver Broncos
Rookie Jonah Coleman rushed 24 times for 111 yards and three scores, all career highs, and the host Denver Broncos held on to beat the Las Vegas Raiders. Bo Nix threw for 225 yards on 19-for-35 passing with a touchdown to Alex Trautman and an interception for Denver (8-2). The Broncos survived a solid performance by Raiders rookie quarterback Fernando Mendoza that was spoiled by Ja’Quan McMillian’s pick-6 with 1:52 left, sealing Denver’s sixth straight win. Mendoza, the first overall pick last spring, finished with the first three touchdown passes of his career in his second career start. He was 18-for-37 for 267 yards, Ashton Jeanty had 79 yards rushing and 90 receiving, including a TD catch, and Ian Thomas and Jack Bech caught touchdown passes for the Raiders (4-7).
Tennessee Titans 30–51 Dallas Cowboys
Dak Prescott threw four touchdown passes and ran for a score, and the Dallas Cowboys reached the end zone on their first six drives in their victory over the Tennessee Titans. Javonte Williams ran for a TD and caught one of Prescott’s scoring passes. Receivers CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens both had 100-yard days with a touchdown apiece. Dallas (5-6) had never scored TDs on its first six possessions going back to at least 1993. The Titans scored five of the first six times they had the ball with two touchdowns and three field goals in a matchup of the NFL’s two worst defenses. The Titans (1-9) clinched a fifth consecutive losing season, the longest such streak since the franchise moved from Houston in 1997.
Jacksonville Jaguars 18–23 New York Giants
JJ McCarthy threw a touchdown pass to Malik Nabers, Abdul Carter and the defense flustered Trevor Lawrence throughout and the New York Giants (6-3-1) held on to defeat the Jacksonville Jaguars (7-3). The Giants ended the AFC South leaders’ winning streak at three games. Carter had two sacks to double his season total. Lawrence threw a pair of interceptions in his worst game this fall.
Baltimore Ravens 33–35 Carolina Panthers
Bryce Young threw for 254 yards and two touchdowns, Chuba Hubbard ran for 120 yards and two more scores and the Carolina Panthers made a late defensive stop to beat Baltimore and send the Ravens (4-7) to their sixth straight loss. Ryan Fitzgerald made a 37-yard field goal with 1:44 left to give the Panthers the lead, marking the seventh and final lead change. Jacoby Brissett’s desperation heave down the right side sideline was intercepted by Tyrel Dodson with 33 seconds left after the pass was broken up by Will Lee III. Lee, a fourth-round draft pick, also had two forced fumbles, including stripping Justice Hill on the goalline resulting in a touchback after a 36-yard run. The defending NFC South champions Panthers (5-5) have a two-game lead in the division over Tampa Bay, Atlanta and New Orleans.
New Orleans Saints 13–21 Chicago Bears
Caleb Williams threw two touchdown passes and the Chicago defense held on as the Bears won their fifth consecutive game. Williams passed for 181 yards and threw one interception for the Bears (8-2). Tyler Shough passed for 222 yards with one touchdown and one interception and was sacked six times, and Chris Olave caught nine passes for 102 yards for the Saints (3-7).
New York Jets 27–24 Los Angeles Chargers
Geno Smith led the New York Jets to victory over the Los Angeles Chargers, ending a five-game losing streak. Smith was 17 of 21 for 176 yards and three touchdowns. He threw a seven-yard TD to Breece Hall that snapped the Jets’ skid of 10 quarters without a score over three games. Jets receiver Sterling Shepard caught two touchdown passes after being elevated from the practice squad a day earlier. The Chargers were coming off their first win of the season but trailed the entire game. Los Angeles’ Justin Herbert threw two touchdown passes. The Jets improved to 3-8, while the Chargers fell 1-9.

https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.title: A economia política do Lula 4: o que está em jogo?
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.author: Leidiano Farias
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.text:
1. A popularização do debate econômico e a disputa pelos rumos do governo
A crescente presença do ajuste fiscal no debate público constitui uma grande conquista para a sociedade brasileira. Como observou Schumpeter, no seu clássico História da Análise Econômica (1964), determinadas questões econômicas, em circunstâncias históricas específicas, ultrapassam os círculos especializados e passam a integrar o “espírito público”, tornando-se objeto das “opiniões populares”. É justamente esse fenômeno que se observa no atual debate sobre o ajuste fiscal no Brasil. Antes, predominantemente restrito aos economistas, aos agentes do mercado financeiro e às instituições governamentais, o tema vem ganhando espaço no debate político e social. Esse espraiamento não ocorre por acaso. Ele expressa a percepção de que as decisões sobre a política fiscal ultrapassam os limites da gestão orçamentária, envolvendo disputas sobre a distribuição da riqueza, o financiamento dos direitos sociais e os rumos do desenvolvimento nacional.
Essa popularização precisa ser acompanhada de análise crítica. No debate sobre o Plano Moretti, identificam-se três posições. A primeira reduz a proposta a uma questão orçamentária para 2027, ignorando seus efeitos sobre os próximos anos. Nesse campo, convivem análises economicistas e ingênuas com posições que, por seguidismo político, procuram minimizar sua abrangência. A segunda reúne setores da esquerda que dirigem suas críticas ao presidente Lula, recorrendo a caracterizações equivocadas, como estelionato eleitoral e traição. A terceira, na qual me situo, compreende que sustentar politicamente o governo não significa renunciar à disputa pelos seus rumos, sobretudo quando está em questão a orientação da política econômica.
2. A correlação de forças para uma nova orientação econômica
A crise econômica de 2008 representou um divisor de águas no aprofundamento da crise estrutural do capitalismo. Desde então, intensificou-se, em escala global, um movimento de recomposição das taxas de lucro do grande capital, sustentado por reformas trabalhistas e previdenciárias, superexploração do trabalho, degradação ambiental e crescente apropriação dos orçamentos nacionais pelo capital financeiro. A crise da democracia liberal, a xenofobia e a ascensão da extrema direita também integram esse processo histórico.
As grandes mobilizações que levaram à vitória do presidente Lula no segundo turno abriram a possibilidade de transitarmos de uma situação de equilíbrio instável de forças para uma correlação de forças mais favorável ao campo popular. Entretanto, essa possibilidade depende da continuidade da mobilização democrática e de sinais efetivos do governo em direção a uma nova agenda de desenvolvimento. O Plano Moretti caminha na direção contrária: seu caráter predominantemente contracionista pode aprofundar a desaceleração econômica e ampliar os riscos de estagnação ou recessão, provocando perda de base social e alimentando projeto ultraliberal e conservador da extrema direita.
O Plano Moretti trouxe à tona a seguinte questão: qual será a economia política do Lula 4? Esse debate não avançou em 2023 quando estava sendo articulado o arcabouço fiscal por duas razões: o papel da frente ampla na vitória de Lula e o fato de o arcabouço fiscal representar um avanço frente ao rígido teto de gastos dos governos Temer e Bolsonaro.
Agora o cenário é outro: o protagonismo na vitória eleitoral foi de uma frente popular, ainda que necessitemos de amplitude e composição como parte da governabilidade junto ao Congresso nacional. Temos, portanto, condições de fazer essa disputa na sociedade, dado o tamanho do movimento que se constituiu no segundo turno.
Trata-se de constituir uma maioria política e social que questione a continuidade de uma dinâmica em que predomina restrições orçamentárias que travam os investimentos estratégicos e ampliação de direitos sociais, que impõem à economia a lógica predominante de uma plataforma de valorização financeira e de produção de bens primários, condenando nosso país a um regime de baixo crescimento do PIB. Como alternativa, devemos levantar a bandeira de um Projeto Nacional de Desenvolvimento, seu padrão de financiamento e os instrumentos de política econômica necessários à transformação produtiva do país. Portanto, não estamos diante somente de uma controvérsia orçamentária.
3. Quadro fiscal e tendência geral da economia brasileira
A desaceleração da economia brasileira reforça as preocupações com os efeitos de uma política fiscal contracionista. Segundo os dados do Instituto Brasileiro de Geografia e Estatística (IBGE), o Produto Interno Bruto (PIB) cresceu 3,2% em 2023, 3,4% em 2024 e desacelerou para 2,3% em 2025. Para 2026, o Ministério da Fazenda projeta um crescimento de apenas 2%, seguido de uma recuperação modesta para 2,3% (cenário relativamente otimista) em 2027. Essa perda de dinamismo também se manifesta no consumo das famílias, cujo crescimento anual recuou de 5,1% em 2024 para apenas 1,3% em 2025. A trajetória de desaceleração prosseguiu em 2026: na comparação com os mesmos períodos do ano anterior, o consumo cresceu 1,7% no primeiro trimestre e apenas 0,5% no segundo. Esses resultados evidenciam o enfraquecimento de um dos principais componentes da demanda agregada, o consumo das famílias, em um contexto de juros elevados e restrições fiscais. Nesse cenário, o aprofundamento do ajuste fiscal, especialmente por meio da compressão das despesas discricionárias e dos investimentos públicos, pode agravar a desaceleração econômica, ampliar os riscos de estagnação e, até mesmo, levar a economia a uma recessão.
É preciso reconhecer que o orçamento brasileiro necessita de ajustes, especialmente para melhorar a qualidade das despesas, enfrentar privilégios e ampliar a eficiência da arrecadação. Entretanto, como veremos, nosso problema fiscal reside centralmente nas chamadas despesas financeiras, sobretudo nos juros da dívida pública, e não propriamente nas despesas primárias, que correspondem aos gastos do Estado com saúde, educação, previdência, pessoal, investimentos e demais políticas públicas, excluídos os juros. Em setembro de 2026, a dívida bruta alcançou 82,9% do PIB, enquanto o déficit nominal, que corresponde à diferença entre receitas e despesas públicas, incluindo os juros da dívida, atingiu 9,51% do PIB no acumulado de 12 meses. O déficit primário, calculado sem considerar os juros, correspondeu a apenas 0,52% do PIB.
Como observou André Lara Resende: “O déficit primário foi inferior ao de cerca de dois terços dos países acompanhados pelo FMI, bem abaixo da média dos emergentes (3,9% do PIB) e das economias avançadas (2,5% do PIB). É o déficit nominal, o que soma as despesas com o serviço da dívida ao déficit primário, que é muito alto (…) a alta taxa de juros reduz o crescimento do PIB e acelera o crescimento da dívida. Ou seja, agrava pelos dois lados — o da dívida e o do PIB — o problema da trajetória insustentável da relação dívida/PIB”. Está evidente o peso determinante das despesas financeiras sobre o problema fiscal brasileiro.
O Plano Moretti: principais pontos
No campo da arrecadação, prevê a redução de benefícios fiscais concedidos a empresas e setores econômicos, além de estabelecer novas limitações à utilização de créditos tributários para compensação de impostos devidos. Também contempla o enfrentamento dos chamados supersalários no serviço público.
No âmbito do arcabouço fiscal, o Plano Moretti estabelece medidas de caráter predominantemente contracionista, entre elas a redução de 2,5% para 2% do limite máximo de crescimento real das despesas públicas nas situações previstas, além da ampliação dos mecanismos de contingenciamento e bloqueio orçamentário para assegurar o cumprimento das metas fiscais. Embora apresentada como uma medida excepcional, essa redução corre o risco de se transformar em um novo padrão permanente de restrição fiscal, uma vez que as dificuldades recorrentes para alcançar o centro da meta podem levar ao acionamento sistemático desse mecanismo.
Os investimentos públicos permanecem submetidos às restrições gerais do arcabouço, ressalvadas as exceções legais. Embora preserve formalmente os pisos constitucionais de saúde e educação, o plano retira determinadas receitas extraordinárias do petróleo da base de cálculo do financiamento mínimo da saúde, o que pode reduzir os recursos obrigatoriamente destinados ao setor em comparação com a regra anterior. As demais despesas sociais também continuam sujeitas às limitações orçamentárias aplicáveis.
Em seu conjunto, as medidas revelam uma assimetria importante: enquanto os mecanismos de contenção das despesas públicas apresentam efeitos mais imediatos, parte das iniciativas destinadas a enfrentar privilégios e ampliar a justiça fiscal depende de regulamentação e implementação posteriores.
4. Política monetária, câmbio e investimento
A superação dessa armadilha exige enfrentar a política monetária restritiva, sustentada por uma meta central de inflação de 3%, que tem justificado juros elevados, mesmo diante de pressões inflacionárias predominantemente associadas a choques de oferta, sobre os quais a elevação dos juros tem eficácia limitada e pode agravar a desaceleração econômica. A revisão da meta para 4%, com banda de tolerância de 1,5 ponto percentual, permitiria maior flexibilidade monetária, preservando a estabilidade de preços. Essa medida deve ser articulada a uma política de câmbio real competitivo e estável, apoiada na utilização estratégica das reservas internacionais e na regulação dos fluxos de capitais, visando fortalecer a indústria nacional e reduzir a vulnerabilidade externa.
O Brasil também precisa elevar substancialmente os investimentos públicos federais, estaduais e municipais, articulando-os à expansão do investimento privado. A Formação Bruta de Capital Fixo, atualmente próxima de 17% do PIB, deve alcançar progressivamente 25%, criando condições para sustentar taxas de crescimento econômico superiores a 4% ao ano. A ampliação da demanda agregada, da capacidade produtiva e da produtividade permitiria elevar a arrecadação e financiar direitos sociais e políticas públicas. Essa estratégia, entretanto, encontra obstáculos nas restrições impostas pelo atual arcabouço fiscal.
5. Disputar o governo e construir um Projeto Nacional de Desenvolvimento
No curto prazo, é necessário ampliar a mobilização social pela redução da taxa Selic, revisão das metas de inflação, retirada dos investimentos públicos estratégicos das restrições do arcabouço fiscal, preservação dos pisos constitucionais da saúde e da educação, fortalecimento das políticas sociais. No campo da arrecadação, destaco a necessidade de ampliação da tributação das altas rendas, dos grandes patrimônios, dos rendimentos do capital financeiro, do lucro bancário, assim como o enfrentamento dos privilégios relacionados aos benefícios fiscais, às compensações financeiras, às emendas parlamentares e aos supersalários. A prioridade é enfrentar os juros elevados e abrir o debate sobre a reforma monetária, o sistema financeiro e a influência do mercado sobre o Banco Central. O Lula 4 deve ser compreendido como um campo de disputa, no qual a defesa do governo e a luta por mudanças estruturais caminhem juntas, acumulando forças para um Projeto Nacional de Desenvolvimento.
* Leidiano Farias é historiador e integra a Coordenação Nacional do Movimento Brasil Popular e a Executiva Estadual do PT-CE

https://taz.de/Neuer-Frankfurt-Tatort/!6.title: Neuer Frankfurt-„Tatort“: Sich verstanden fühlen
https://taz.de/Neuer-Frankfurt-Tatort/!6.author: Aida Baghernejad
https://taz.de/Neuer-Frankfurt-Tatort/!6.text:
Neuer Frankfurt-„Tatort“: Sich verstanden fühlen
Im neuen FFM-„Tatort“ werden Motive des „Mykonos-Attentats“ verarbeitet und weitergesponnen. Das ist an sich schon spannend – aber es geht um mehr.
Ein bisschen Lokalpatriotismus gehört zum „Tatort“ dazu: Auch wenn ich Südhessen seit gut 20 Jahren verlassen habe, löst ein Kameraschwenk über Frankfurter Bankentürme ein wohliges Heimatgefühl bei mir aus.
Seit letztes Jahr allerdings Melika Foroutan und Edin Hasanović als Maryam Azadi und Hamza Kulina den 069er-„Tatort“ übernommen haben, kommt ein anderes Gefühl dazu: sich verstanden fühlen.
Weder sind die beiden die ersten postmigrantischen Schauspieler:innen im „Tatort“ noch sind ihre Figuren die ersten postmigrantischen Ermittler:innen. Und trotzdem ist da etwas anders bei ihren Frankfurter Geschichten, sie zeigen keine Draufsicht auf vielfältiges Leben in Deutschland, sondern eine Innensicht.
Für die man übrigens, wie das Autoren- und Regieteam (Buch: Constantin Lieb, Andreas Prochaska, Vorlage: Markus Busch, Regie: Andreas Prochaska) hinter „4 Finger“ zeigt, gar nicht unbedingt aus der Community kommen muss. Es reichen auch ein Wissen um jüngere deutsche Geschichte, ehrliches Interesse und Empathie, die die Nöte von migrantisierten Communitys nicht als das andere begreift, sondern als dazugehörig.
Mykonos-Attentat 1992
Und vielleicht auch, dass man seine Schauspieler:innen, wie hier die auch für die iranische Diaspora politische aktive Melika Foroutan, als Ideengeber:innen ernst nimmt.
Der vierte Fall des Duos greift nämlich das schon im ersten Film der Reihe angeteaserte Geheimnis der Figur Azadi auf und spinnt daraus eine fiktive Geschichte, die stark vom Mykonos-Attentat 1992 in Berlin inspiriert ist.
Damals starben kurdisch-iranische Exilpolitiker bei einem mutmaßlich vom iranischen Geheimdienst in Auftrag gegebenen Anschlag auf ein griechisches Lokal. Bis heute liegen viele Aspekte des Falls im Dunklen, verurteilte Attentäter wurden vorzeitig freigelassen und abgeschoben.
Und bis heute scheint es, als ob dieser Fall kaum als Teil der politischen Geschichte Deutschlands gesehen wird, wie die Autorin Maryam Aras in ihrem Buch „Dinosaurierkind“ schreibt, obwohl er sich mitten in Deutschland abgespielt hat, obwohl deutsche Polizei und Politik darin verwickelt waren.
Die reale Paranoia migrantischer und postmigrantischer Oppositioneller in Deutschland, die Sorge vor dem langen Arm vieler autoritärer Regime, greift dieser „Tatort“ mit den Mitteln des Thrillers auf, verlegt die Geschichte nach Frankfurt und spinnt sie beklemmend dicht weiter.
Und schafft es damit vielleicht sogar zu zeigen, dass die Nöte der vermeintlich „anderen“ immer auch die eigenen sein werden.
Gemeinsam für freie Presse
Die taz gehört zu 100 Prozent ihren Leser:innen und ist damit nicht nur konzernfrei, sondern auch kostenfrei zugänglich. Alle Artikel stellen wir frei zur Verfügung, ohne Paywall. Gerade in diesen Zeiten müssen Einordnungen und Informationen allen zugänglich sein. Unsere Leser:innen müssen nichts bezahlen, wissen aber, dass kritischer, unabhängiger Journalismus nicht aus dem Nichts entsteht. Dafür sind wir sehr dankbar. Damit wir auch morgen noch unseren Journalismus machen können, brauchen wir mehr Unterstützung für taz zahl ich. Dank Ihnen haben wir nun die 50.000 erreicht. So viele unterstützen freiwillig und regelmäßig. Noch nicht dabei? Werden Sie jetzt Teil der Community! Jetzt unterstützen

https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2026/n.title: Marc Márquez claims record-equalling eighth MotoGP world title in Portugal
https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2026/n.author: Reuters
https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2026/n.text:
Marc Márquez sealed the 2026 MotoGP world title at the Portuguese Grand Prix on Sunday, after his eighth-placed finish proved enough to establish an unassailable lead in the overall standings.
The Ducati rider needed to finish in the top nine in Sunday’s race and despite starting second on the grid, Márquez rode with caution to finish eighth and seal the title with a round to spare. The Spaniard’s eighth premier-class title puts him alongside the great Giacomo Agostini at the top of motorcycle racing’s all-time standings.
The race in Portimão was won by Marco Bezzecchi, who held a 102-point advantage over Márquez at one stage this season, while his Aprilia teammate Jorge Martín and Trackhouse rider Raúl Fernández completed the podium.
All eyes were on Márquez, who marked the occasion by scaling a scaffold to address the cheering fans, before watching a big-screen montage of the defining moments of his career. As a final flourish, the Spaniard ascended a staircase accompanied by the silhouette of a goat on the screen, a nod to his growing “greatest of all time” status, before receiving a golden commemorative helmet from Agostini himself.
“We need to be happy. I know that we are here celebrating a historic moment. I know how I suffered,” said an emotional Márquez. He underwent double surgery on his foot and shoulder midway through the season, after a crash at the French Grand Prix in May.
“I know that in the middle of the season, the fans believed more than I did. My people believed more than I did. But I kept pushing, I kept doing my best,” he added. “I said last year that it was a championship where I was at peace with myself. This one is for all the fans that believed in me from 2020 until now. So thanks to all of you, this is for all of you.”
Márquez came agonisingly close to securing the title in Saturday’s sprint but his hopes were dashed when he crashed out on the penultimate lap while running in third place, a finish that would have been sufficient to crown him champion.
Unlike Saturday’s overcast conditions with spots of rain on the circuit, Sunday’s 25-lap race at the Algarve International Circuit was held in bright sunshine.
Martín needed to outscore Marquez by 18 points while the defending champion’s equation was far more simple: secure a top-nine finish regardless of his rivals’ results to get his hands on the trophy again.
Márquez had been cautious in the sprint but this time he shot off the line to take the lead from polesitter Bezzecchi while several riders jostled for position behind him, with Martín moving up from seventh to fourth. Márquez was soon swallowed up by the faster Aprilia bikes around him, quickly falling to seventh as he exercised caution amid aggressive overtaking.
Pedro Acosta’s crash moved Márquez up to sixth but he had to concede two places to Fabio Di Giannantonio and Ai Ogura, with the 33-year-old rider happy to open the door to let them pass knowing eighth would be good enough for the title.
Up front, Bezzecchi finally moved past Fernández to take the lead on lap 15, while Martín also found a way past three laps later with an identical overtake to make it an Aprilia factory one-two.
On lap 19, Márquez fell to ninth as KTM’s Brad Binder nudged him aside, but a crash from Diogo Moreira on the last lap moved Márquez back up to eighth, and he held on to secure his 10th Grand Prix crown overall having previously won a title in both the Moto2 and Moto3 classes.
“Super happy about the season, obviously some highs and some lows, but my best season in MotoGP so far,” said Bezzecchi, who also missed races this season through injury.
“Still a lot of things to improve. But congrats to Marc, he really deserves everything. He’s one of the strongest riders in history, so to fight with him is an honour,” the Italian added. “Hopefully next year I will fight again and make his life even harder.“

https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.title: Tupanciretã (RS) decreta estado de calamidade pública após vendaval e tempestade
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.author: Redação
https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2026/11/.text:
O município de Tupanciretã, na região central do Rio Grande do Sul, decretou estado de calamidade pública após ser atingido por um forte vendaval e uma tempestade que provocaram destruição em toda a cidade. Cinco mortes foram confirmadas em decorrência dos temporais no estado.
Com aproximadamente 20 mil habitantes, Tupanciretã teve 100% de seu território afetado direta ou indiretamente pelos fortes ventos e pela chuva, segundo avaliação da prefeitura. Os estragos atingiram residências, estabelecimentos comerciais, prédios públicos e a infraestrutura urbana e rural.
O temporal provocou a queda de árvores e postes, destelhamentos e bloqueios de vias. Diante da dimensão dos danos, a administração municipal decretou calamidade pública em todo o território, medida que permite ampliar a mobilização de recursos e equipes para atender à população e recuperar as áreas atingidas.
O governo do Rio Grande do Sul disponibilizou maquinário para auxiliar nos trabalhos de limpeza, retirada de entulhos e desobstrução de estradas e ruas. Também foram mobilizados caminhões para apoiar os serviços de recuperação e o abastecimento de água.
Na área da saúde, a Força Nacional do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS) mobilizou 13 profissionais para reforçar o atendimento à população. A equipe reúne médicos, enfermeiros, técnicos de enfermagem, psicólogo e assistente social.
Os profissionais vão atuar em conjunto com as equipes locais, tanto na assistência aos moradores quanto na avaliação das necessidades da rede municipal de saúde, que também sofreu os impactos do temporal.
Solidariedade
O temporal também atingiu famílias do Acampamento Herdeiros da Luta, do Movimento dos Trabalhadores Rurais Sem Terra (MST), que iniciou uma campanha de solidariedade para reconstruir as moradias danificadas.
“A cidade é assim, a cidade é uma terra rasada, não sobrou praticamente nada detelhado”, relatou Sérgio dos Reis Marques, da direção estadual do MST, após percorrer o município na sexta-feira. Segundo ele, os ventos arrancaram telhados, destruíram postes e deixaram moradores sem acesso a serviços essenciais.
Chuvas também provocam estragos em Aparecida (SP)
Em São Paulo, o município de Aparecida também registrou ocorrências graves provocadas pelas chuvas. Foram registrados alagamentos, quedas de árvores, deslizamentos de terra e danos em estruturas.
Seis pessoas ficaram desalojadas e foram acolhidas por familiares. Em uma das ocorrências, parte da estrutura de um hotel cedeu, deixando cinco hóspedes feridos. Eles receberam atendimento médico e apresentavam escoriações leves, sem risco à vida.
Outro deslizamento de terra atingiu uma residência na Rua Padre Gebardo. Dois moradores ficaram soterrados e foram resgatados pelas equipes de emergência.
O órgão também reforçou o alerta para a ocorrência de chuvas em todo o estado entre domingo (22) e terça-feira (24). A previsão inclui pancadas de moderada a forte intensidade, raios, rajadas de vento e possibilidade de granizo isolado.
